coverage_notes: Dataset/category sizes use the complete filtered inventory workbook, with Objaverse updated from its cross-validated 434-category CSV and progress tables.

Alignment records describe checked rotations (Objaverse), mesh/alignment reports (Omni6DPose), or nonempty canonical mesh exports matching the complete category inventory (3D-FUTURE). Unavailable consolidated counts remain null.
Rendered instance counts refer to instance packages, each checked for 150 RGB, mask and NOCS views; not a count of images.

ShapeNet: maximum validated per-category count from batches 1/2 and 3/4; invalid entries are subtracted before taking the maximum. Overlapping car batches are not added. This is a per-category validated lower bound, not a deduplicated union of batch IDs.
Objaverse and Omni6DPose render reports retain their existing exact category mappings.
Point positions are schematic; category overview sheets and individual render examples are representative outputs, not a claim that every catalogue entry is pictured.

The broader raw-metadata union (134,644 entries / 1,100 groups) is superseded here by the project filtered inventory (131,352 / 1,091). Omni6DPose excludes 592 real-metadata records without meshes; HSSD uses its 400-category filtered object inventory.

Coordinate-frame previews are unmodified embedded PNGs from dataset_info.xlsx, mapped by source dataset, category and image anchor row. Its instance_count values describe different processing inventories and do not override the filtered catalogue or validation reports.
